name: Everyday Current Account
summary: A no-fee current account with a contactless debit card, instant spending notifications and an arranged overdraft you apply for separately.
detail: The account most of our customers hold. There is no monthly fee and no minimum funding requirement. Spending is categorised automatically, and you can freeze the card, set limits or block gambling transactions from the app at any time.
rateCaption: Arranged overdraft 39.9% EAR variable, subject to status
highlights: No monthly account fee
Freeze and unfreeze your card instantly
Switch in seven working days under the Current Account Switch Service
eligibility: You are 18 or over and a UK resident
You can provide proof of identity and address

name: Reward Current Account
summary: Cashback on household direct debits for a fixed monthly fee. Worth having if your bills run through this account.
detail: Pay a £5 monthly fee and earn cashback on eligible household direct debits including energy, water, council tax and broadband. The account is worth holding only if your bills clear it, and the comparison on this page shows the break-even point honestly.
rateCaption: On eligible household direct debits, capped at £5 a month
highlights: 3% cashback on eligible household direct debits
Cashback capped at £5 a month, so the account breaks even at £167 of bills
Includes mobile phone and travel insurance for the account holder
eligibility: You are 18 or over and a UK resident
You pay at least £1,000 into the account each month
You hold at least two eligible direct debits

name: Premier Current Account
summary: For customers with £75,000 in savings and investments with us, or a salary of £75,000 or more. Named relationship manager included.
detail: Premier gives you a named relationship manager, preferential rates on savings and mortgages, and worldwide family travel cover. It is a relationship product rather than a transactional one, and it is only worth holding if you use the adviser.
rateCaption: Fee waived while you hold £75,000 with us
highlights: Named relationship manager you can call directly
Preferential rates on savings, mortgages and foreign exchange
Worldwide family travel insurance included
eligibility: You hold £75,000 or more in savings and investments with Meridian
Or your annual income paid into the account is £75,000 or more

name: Business Current Account
summary: For sole traders and limited companies turning over up to £2 million, with 18 months of free day-to-day banking.
detail: Free day-to-day business banking for the first 18 months, then an £8.50 monthly fee. Includes accounting software integration, multi-user access with per-user permissions, and a named business manager once turnover passes £250,000.
feeDisplay: Free for 18 months, then £8.50 a month
highlights: 18 months of free day-to-day banking
Multi-user access with per-user payment permissions
Direct feeds into the main accounting packages
eligibility: Your business is registered in the UK
Annual turnover is under £2 million
All directors and beneficial owners can be identity checked

name: Easy Access Saver
summary: Withdraw whenever you like with no notice and no penalty. The rate is variable and we will tell you before it drops.
detail: An instant access account for money you may need at short notice. The rate is variable, which means it can move at any time, and we give 14 days notice before any reduction. There is no bonus rate that quietly expires.
highlights: Unlimited withdrawals with no notice period
No introductory bonus that expires after a year
14 days notice before any rate reduction
eligibility: You are 16 or over and a UK resident

name: One Year Fixed Rate Saver
summary: A higher rate in exchange for locking the money away for twelve months. No withdrawals during the term.
detail: You fix the rate for twelve months and cannot withdraw before maturity. That is the trade: a better rate for giving up access. We write to you 30 days before maturity so the balance never rolls silently onto a worse rate.
highlights: Rate fixed for the full twelve months
No withdrawals until maturity
We write to you 30 days before the term ends
eligibility: You are 18 or over and a UK resident
You can deposit at least £1,000 within 14 days of opening

name: Cash ISA
summary: Tax-free interest up to the annual ISA allowance, with transfers in from other providers accepted.
detail: Interest is paid free of UK income tax within your annual ISA allowance. You can transfer existing ISAs in without using this year's allowance, and we handle the transfer with your old provider rather than asking you to.
highlights: Interest paid free of UK income tax
Transfers in accepted without using this year's allowance
Withdraw and replace within the same tax year without losing the allowance

keyFacts.label: Flexible
keyFacts.value: Yes, replace withdrawals same tax year

eligibility: You are 18 or over and a UK resident for tax purposes
You have not subscribed to another cash ISA this tax year

name: Stocks and Shares ISA
summary: Invest your ISA allowance in one of five risk-rated portfolios. The value can fall as well as rise.
detail: You choose a risk level from cautious to adventurous and we manage the portfolio. This is an investment, not a savings account: the value can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you put in. There is no FSCS protection against investment losses.
highlights: Five risk-rated portfolios, from cautious to adventurous
Start from £100, or £25 a month
Capital at risk: the value can fall as well as rise
eligibility: You are 18 or over and a UK resident for tax purposes
You have not subscribed to another stocks and shares ISA this tax year
riskWarning: The value of investments can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you invested. Past performance is not a guide to future performance.

name: First Home Mortgage
summary: A five-year fixed rate for first-time buyers, with deposits accepted from 5% and the standard valuation paid by us.
detail: Built for a first purchase. Deposits start at 5%, we pay the standard valuation, and one adviser stays with you from the first conversation through to completion. You can hold the rate for six months while you look, which matters in a moving market.
rateCaption: Fixed for five years, then 7.99% variable
highlights: Deposits accepted from 5% of the purchase price
Standard valuation paid by us
Rate held for six months while you look
eligibility: Neither applicant has owned a property before
You are buying a home you will live in
You have a deposit of at least 5% of the purchase price
representativeExample: A mortgage of £180,000 payable over 25 years on our First Home rate of 4.39% fixed for five years and then 7.99% variable would require 60 monthly payments of £989.61 and 240 monthly payments of £1,320.44. The total amount payable would be £376,282, including a £999 product fee. The overall cost for comparison is 6.8% APRC representative.

name: Five Year Fixed Rate Mortgage
summary: Five years of certainty on the payment, for buyers and remortgagers with a 25% deposit or more.
detail: The lowest rate in our residential range, available where you have at least 25% equity or deposit. Five years of fixed payments, with 10% annual overpayments allowed without charge.
rateCaption: Fixed for five years, then 7.99% variable
highlights: Our lowest residential fixed rate
Overpay up to 10% a year with no early repayment charge
Requires 25% deposit or equity
eligibility: You have a deposit or equity of at least 25%
The property is in the UK and you will live in it
representativeExample: A mortgage of £250,000 payable over 25 years on our Five Year Fixed rate of 4.09% fixed for five years and then 7.99% variable would require 60 monthly payments of £1,330.19 and 240 monthly payments of £1,806.29. The total amount payable would be £513,320, including a £1,499 product fee. The overall cost for comparison is 6.6% APRC representative.

name: Remortgage Two Year Fixed
summary: Move your mortgage to us on a two-year fix, with legal work and valuation included.
detail: For customers coming off a fixed rate elsewhere. We cover the standard legal work and the valuation, and there is no product fee. A shorter fix if you expect rates to fall and want to review sooner.
rateCaption: Fixed for two years, then 7.99% variable
highlights: No product fee
Standard legal work and valuation included
Two-year term if you want to review sooner
eligibility: You already own the property and have at least 15% equity
The mortgage being replaced is with another lender
representativeExample: A mortgage of £200,000 payable over 20 years on our Remortgage rate of 4.64% fixed for two years and then 7.99% variable would require 24 monthly payments of £1,281.36 and 216 monthly payments of £1,590.09. The total amount payable would be £374,213, with no product fee. The overall cost for comparison is 7.4% APRC representative.

name: Buy to Let Mortgage
summary: For landlords with up to four properties. Interest only available, assessed on rental cover.
detail: Assessed on the rent the property will produce rather than your salary alone. We require rental cover of 145% of the monthly interest at a stressed rate. Buy to let mortgages are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.
rateCaption: Fixed for five years, interest only available
highlights: Interest only or capital repayment
Portfolios of up to four properties considered
Rental cover assessed at 145% of stressed interest

keyFacts.label: Regulated
keyFacts.value: No, buy to let is generally unregulated

eligibility: You own or are buying a property to let to tenants
You have a deposit of at least 25%
You hold no more than four mortgaged rental properties
representativeExample: Buy to let mortgages are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority. Your property may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on a mortgage secured against it.

name: Personal Loan
summary: Borrow £1,000 to £35,000 over one to seven years, with the rate you are offered shown before you apply.
detail: A soft eligibility check shows the rate you would actually get without leaving a mark on your credit file. Fixed monthly payments for the whole term, and you can settle early with no more than 58 days interest as a charge.
highlights: See your rate without affecting your credit score
Fixed monthly payments for the whole term
Settle early for no more than 58 days interest
eligibility: You are 18 or over and a UK resident
You have a regular income
You have no county court judgments in the last six years
representativeExample: Representative example: borrowing £10,000 over 60 months at a representative 6.9% APR, with monthly repayments of £196.87. Total amount payable £11,812.20. Total charge for credit £1,812.20. The rate you are offered depends on your circumstances.

name: Car Finance Loan
summary: An unsecured loan for a vehicle, so you own the car outright from day one with no mileage limits.
detail: Unlike a personal contract purchase, this is a straightforward loan. You own the car from the start, there are no mileage restrictions and no balloon payment at the end. That usually costs more per month and less overall.
highlights: You own the vehicle from day one
No mileage limits and no balloon payment
Funds usually available the next working day
eligibility: You are 18 or over and a UK resident
You have a regular income
representativeExample: Representative example: borrowing £15,000 over 60 months at a representative 7.4% APR, with monthly repayments of £298.24. Total amount payable £17,894.40. Total charge for credit £2,894.40.

name: Home Improvement Loan
summary: Borrow up to £50,000 for building work without adding it to your mortgage or extending the term.
detail: For extensions, kitchens and energy efficiency work. Keeping the borrowing separate from your mortgage costs more in interest per year but avoids paying it back over 25 years. A lower rate applies to qualifying energy efficiency improvements.
highlights: Keeps the borrowing off your mortgage term
5.9% APR on qualifying energy efficiency improvements
Terms up to ten years
eligibility: You own the property being improved
You are 18 or over and a UK resident
representativeExample: Representative example: borrowing £20,000 over 84 months at a representative 6.4% APR, with monthly repayments of £294.44. Total amount payable £24,732.96. Total charge for credit £4,732.96.

name: Meridian Classic Card
summary: An everyday credit card with 0% on purchases for 18 months and no annual fee.
detail: A simple card for spreading the cost of a purchase. There is no annual fee. The 0% period applies to purchases only, and the rate reverts to 19.9% variable afterwards, so clearing the balance before month 19 is the point of it.
highlights: 0% on purchases for 18 months
No annual fee
Section 75 protection on purchases over £100
eligibility: You are 18 or over and a UK resident
You have a regular income of at least £10,000 a year
representativeExample: Representative example: 19.9% APR representative variable. Based on an assumed credit limit of £1,200 and a purchase rate of 19.9% p.a. variable.

name: Meridian Balance Transfer Card
summary: Move existing card debt and pay 0% interest on it for 28 months, for a 2.9% transfer fee.
detail: For clearing expensive debt from elsewhere. The 2.9% transfer fee is charged up front, so moving £5,000 costs £145. That is almost always cheaper than paying 22% for two years, but the card only works if you stop spending on the old one.
rateCaption: Representative variable, after 28 months at 0% on transfers
highlights: 0% on balance transfers for 28 months
2.9% transfer fee, so £5,000 costs £145 to move
Transfers must be made within 60 days of opening
eligibility: You are 18 or over and a UK resident
The balance being transferred is not already with Meridian
representativeExample: Representative example: 22.9% APR representative variable. Based on an assumed credit limit of £1,200 and a purchase rate of 22.9% p.a. variable.

name: Meridian Platinum Card
summary: One point for every pound spent, redeemable against flights or statement credit, with no fees abroad.
detail: A rewards card for people who clear the balance every month. Carrying a balance at 21.9% wipes out the value of the points several times over, and we would rather say so than not. No foreign transaction fees on spending abroad.
highlights: One point per pound, redeemable against flights or statement credit
No foreign transaction fees
Worth holding only if you clear the balance monthly
eligibility: You are 18 or over and a UK resident
You have an income of at least £25,000 a year
representativeExample: Representative example: 27.5% APR representative variable, based on an assumed credit limit of £1,200, a purchase rate of 21.9% p.a. variable and the £120 annual fee.

name: Meridian Infinite Card
summary: By invitation. A metal card with a dedicated relationship manager, worldwide family travel cover and lounge access for two guests.
detail: Offered to Private and Premier customers by invitation. The annual fee is £295 and the benefits are worth more than that only if you travel several times a year. Your relationship manager will tell you plainly whether it is worth holding.
highlights: Dedicated relationship manager
Worldwide family travel insurance
Airport lounge access with two guests
eligibility: You hold a Premier or Private relationship with Meridian
You have been invited to apply
representativeExample: Representative example: 51.4% APR representative variable, based on an assumed credit limit of £1,200, a purchase rate of 22.9% p.a. variable and the £295 annual fee.

name: Meridian Student Card
summary: A first credit card with a low limit, built to establish a credit history rather than to borrow on.
detail: Limits start at £250 and rise only when you ask and we can see the account has been run well. The point of this card is a credit history, not credit. We will not raise the limit automatically.
highlights: Limits from £250, raised only on request
No annual fee
Builds a credit history for a first mortgage later
eligibility: You are 18 or over and enrolled on a UK course of at least two years
You hold a Meridian student or everyday current account
representativeExample: Representative example: 18.9% APR representative variable. Based on an assumed credit limit of £250 and a purchase rate of 18.9% p.a. variable.

name: Managed Portfolio
summary: A discretionary portfolio managed to your risk profile, from £50,000. Capital at risk.
detail: We build and rebalance the portfolio to the risk level agreed at your first review, and report quarterly. This is an investment service: the value can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you invested.
rateCaption: Annual management charge, plus underlying fund costs
highlights: Discretionary management against an agreed risk profile
Quarterly reporting and an annual review with your adviser
Capital at risk: the value can fall as well as rise
eligibility: You have at least £50,000 to invest
You have completed a risk profile assessment with an adviser
riskWarning: The value of investments can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you invested. Past performance is not a guide to future performance.

name: Personal Pension
summary: A self-invested personal pension with tax relief on contributions and access from age 57.
detail: Contributions receive tax relief at your marginal rate within the annual allowance. Money is locked until age 57 under current rules, which is the trade for the relief. Transfers in from other pensions are accepted after an advice check.
highlights: Tax relief on contributions within the annual allowance
Transfers in accepted after an advice check
Not accessible until age 57 under current rules
eligibility: You are under 75 and a UK resident for tax purposes
riskWarning: The value of investments can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you invested. Tax treatment depends on individual circumstances and may change.

name: Home Insurance
summary: Buildings and contents cover with an excess you choose, and claims handled by one named person.
detail: Buildings, contents or both. You set the excess, which moves the premium. Every claim is handled by one named person from first call to settlement rather than passed between departments.
rateCaption: Based on a typical three bedroom house
highlights: Buildings, contents or combined cover
Choose your excess and see the premium move
One named claims handler from first call to settlement
eligibility: The property is in the UK and is your main residence
The property has not flooded in the last five years

name: Life Insurance
summary: Level or decreasing term cover to pay off a mortgage or leave a lump sum, from £6 a month.
detail: Decreasing cover tracks a repayment mortgage down and costs less. Level cover stays flat and leaves a lump sum. Writing the policy in trust usually keeps the payout outside the estate for inheritance tax, and costs nothing to arrange.
rateCaption: Based on a 30 year old non-smoker, £150,000 over 25 years
highlights: Level or decreasing term cover
Written in trust at no extra cost
Terminal illness cover included as standard
eligibility: You are between 18 and 65
You are a UK resident registered with a GP

name: Travel Insurance
summary: Single trip or annual multi-trip cover, with medical conditions assessed rather than automatically excluded.
detail: Annual cover works out cheaper than three single trips for most people. Existing medical conditions are assessed individually rather than excluded by default, and the assessment is free whether or not you buy.
highlights: Single trip or annual multi-trip
Medical conditions assessed individually, free of charge
Emergency medical cover up to £10 million
eligibility: You are a UK resident
Your trip starts and ends in the UK
